featured.titleZh: 中国绿色技术如何削弱特朗普在非洲的“钻探”石油战略
featured.summaryZh: 非洲国家在能源选择上更倾向于成本效益，中国在太阳能和电池技术方面的优势使其在非洲市场更具竞争力。相比之下，美国特朗普政府推行的石油开采战略在非洲面临挑战。

featured.titleZh: 非常具有实质性！泽连斯基与特朗普女婿等人谈了3个小时，美国穿梭外交能否促成停火？
featured.summaryZh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基与特朗普的女婿及相关人员进行了长达三小时的深入会谈。外界关注此次接触是否预示着美国将通过穿梭外交推动俄乌冲突的停火进程。
featured.whyImportant: 此次高层会晤可能对俄乌冲突的未来走向及美国在其中的调停角色产生关键影响。

featured.summaryZh: 菲律宾国防部长表示，尽管美国已给予明确承诺，但担心美韩军演规模的削减可能促使中国在地区事务中采取更强硬的姿态。马尼拉方面正密切关注地区安全动态。

featured.titleZh: 普拉博沃与普京的互动：印尼与俄罗斯领导人的关系能否转化为实质利益？
featured.summaryZh: 印尼总统普拉博沃在东方经济论坛期间与俄罗斯总统普京会面，并就此前缺席俄方活动表达歉意。双方展现出的良好互动引发外界关注，探讨这种个人关系是否能为两国带来实际合作成果。
featured.whyImportant: 印尼作为重要的新兴经济体，其与俄罗斯的互动反映了全球南方国家在复杂地缘政治环境下的外交策略。

featured.titleZh: 让·纳西夫之女在法庭承认受父指使伪造文件以获取1.5亿澳元建筑贷款
featured.summaryZh: 澳大利亚建筑商Toplace老板之女阿什琳·纳西夫承认，在父亲的压力下伪造文件，以获取西太平洋银行的1.5亿澳元贷款。该笔资金曾用于悉尼西北部的公寓楼建设。
featured.whyImportant: 此案揭露了建筑行业内部的欺诈行为，并引发了对大型开发商合规性及贷款审批流程的广泛关注。

featured.summaryZh: 美国重启穿梭外交以寻求俄乌冲突的突破，目前双方已达成短暂停火。然而，由于双方立场分歧巨大，和平进程依然充满不确定性。
featured.whyImportant: 外交斡旋的重启表明国际社会对冲突升级的担忧，但短期停火能否转化为长期和平仍有待观察。

Israel said it had targeted Hezbollah operatives and sites in response to a drone attack a day earlier by the Iran-backed group on its troops in the vicinity of a strategic south Lebanon ridge. It reported no casualties but accused Hezbollah of a “blatant violation”. Israel...

featured.titleZh: 黎巴嫩总统呼吁美国提供援助，以色列空袭造成7人死亡
featured.summaryZh: 黎巴嫩总统约瑟夫·奥恩呼吁华盛顿及国际社会协助制止以色列的袭击，尽管此前已达成停火协议，但周日的空袭仍造成至少7人死亡。以色列称此举是针对真主党前一日无人机袭击的回应，并指责真主党严重违反停火协议。
featured.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了黎以边境停火协议的脆弱性，以及地区冲突升级对国际外交调停构成的严峻挑战。

global.title: More than 200 people stood down at embattled housing developer Bathla amid $3.4bn debt

The insolvency advisory Teneo said on Monday that new short-term funding arrangements would only allow Bathla to continue construction on some of its 45 construction sites, though it did not identify which projects were being prioritised. global.titleZh: 深陷34亿澳元债务危机，建筑开发商Bathla裁员超200人
global.summaryZh: 总部位于悉尼的Bathla集团因面临34亿澳元债务危机，已暂停部分建筑工地施工并裁减了200多名员工。目前破产管理方正寻求紧急资金以避免公司全面倒闭。
global.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了澳大利亚建筑行业在债务压力下的脆弱性，可能对当地房地产市场和就业产生连锁反应。

global.title: Germany’s far-right AfD thanks Elon Musk as France warns state election win a ‘serious moment’
global.summary: Lead candidate in Saxony-Anhalt welcomes further ‘strong’ cooperation with Musk as French minister says ‘we cannot forget our history’ AfD wins key German state election but falls just short of majority The candidate who led the far-right Alternative für Deutschland party to a historic state election victory in Germany has thanked Elon Musk for his support, as one French minister warned that this was a “serious moment” for Europe. The AfD more than doubled its support in the Saxony-Anhalt region and appears to be on the brink of becoming the first far-right party to gain power in Germany at state level since the second world war. global.titleZh: 德国极右翼政党AfD感谢埃隆·马斯克，法国警告其选举获胜是“严重时刻”
global.summaryZh: 德国极右翼政党“德国选择党”（AfD）在萨克森-安哈尔特州选举中取得历史性胜利，并对马斯克的支持表示感谢。法国政府对此表示担忧，称这是欧洲面临的“严重时刻”。
global.whyImportant: AfD的崛起反映了欧洲政治版图的右倾趋势，引发了国际社会对欧洲政治稳定及历史教训的讨论。

global.title: Falklands row shows urgent need to commit to 3% target, says Labour defence committee chair
global.summary: Exclusive: Tan Dhesi says Argentinian threats make it more crucial than ever that PM increase defence spending Javier Milei’s threats to the Falkland Islands make it even more important that Andy Burnham increase defence spending immediately, according to the Labour chair of the defence committee. Tan Dhesi said the comments by the Argentinian president this week show why the government should raise military spending to 3% of GDP by 2030. But he said Burnham’s plans remain mired in confusion after the prime minister appeared to reassure him that the 2030 target would be hit, only for Downing Street to later retreat. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
global.titleZh: 工党国防委员会主席：马尔维纳斯群岛争端凸显增加国防预算至3%的紧迫性
global.summaryZh: 工党国防委员会主席坦·德西表示，鉴于阿根廷总统米莱对马尔维纳斯群岛的威胁，英国必须立即将国防支出提高至GDP的3%。尽管首相曾做出承诺，但政府在具体执行目标上仍存在混乱。
global.whyImportant: 此议题反映了英国在应对地缘政治威胁与财政预算约束之间的矛盾，以及国防政策在政坛的敏感性。

global.title: 埃及各界人士高度评价习近平主席国事访问

global.summaryZh: 埃及各界人士对习近平主席的国事访问给予高度评价，认为此访深化了双边关系。各方期待双方在多领域开展更深层次的合作。
global.whyImportant: 此次访问进一步巩固了中埃全面战略伙伴关系，对推动中阿合作具有重要意义。

global.title: Far-right AfD wins key German state election but falls just short of majority
global.summary: Alternative für Deutschland surges to victory in Saxony-Anhalt as Friedrich Merz’s CDU slumps to disastrous result AfD thanks Elon Musk as France warns state election win a ‘serious moment’ The populist, far-right, anti-immigration Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) has surged to a resounding victory in a crucial state election in Germany, but fell just short of winning a majority in its quest to form the country’s first far-right state government since the second world war. The party of Germany’s unpopular chancellor Friedrich Merz, the Christian Democrats (CDU), slumped to a disastrous result in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt. Continue reading...

global.titleZh: 德国极右翼政党AfD在关键州选举中获胜，但未获得多数席位
global.summaryZh: 德国选择党（AfD）在萨克森-安哈尔特州选举中取得重大胜利，而基民盟（CDU）表现惨淡。尽管AfD势头强劲，但未能获得多数席位以组建二战后德国首个极右翼州政府。
global.whyImportant: 此次选举结果反映了德国政治格局的剧烈变动及极右翼势力的持续扩张，对德国政坛稳定性产生深远影响。

global.whyImportant: 霍尔木兹海峡是全球能源运输的关键咽喉，伊朗的这一举动可能加剧地区紧张局势并影响国际油价。

china.title: ‘There are trade-offs’: how Hong Kong patients can use telemedicine wisely

Hong Kong housewife Chan Ket-yee, nearly 60, has battled severe eczema on her neck and underarms for decades. Splitting her time between the United Kingdom and the city, Chan saw a dramatic improvement after visiting a Hong Kong public dermatologist, whose...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
china.titleZh: “有利有弊”：香港患者如何明智地使用远程医疗

items.titleZh: 伊朗宣布将在霍尔木兹海峡外设立限制区
items.summaryZh: 伊朗安全部门负责人穆赫辛·雷扎伊表示，德黑兰方面将宣布在霍尔木兹海峡周边设立一个限制区。此举引发了外界对该地区航运安全的关注。
items.whyImportant: 霍尔木兹海峡是全球能源运输的关键咽喉，伊朗的这一举动可能加剧地区紧张局势并影响国际油价。

items.title: China to pump $54bn into state banks and insurers to boost economy
items.summary: It comes as Beijing is aiming to reshape its economy in the face of a number of challenges.
items.titleZh: 中国将向国有银行和保险公司注资540亿美元以提振经济
items.summaryZh: 面对多重经济挑战，北京计划向国有金融机构注入540亿美元资金。此举旨在通过增强金融体系实力来推动经济结构调整与增长。
items.whyImportant: 这是中国政府为应对经济下行压力、稳定金融市场所采取的重大财政干预措施。

items.title: ‘There are trade-offs’: how Hong Kong patients can use telemedicine wisely
items.summary: In the fourth instalment of a five-part Health Matters wellness series on Hong Kong’s growing wellness trends, Lo Hoi-ying examines how telehealth is reshaping access to care, as practitioners warn it cannot fully replace in-person diagnosis. Hong Kong housewife Chan Ket-yee, nearly 60, has battled severe eczema on her neck and underarms for decades. Splitting her time between the United Kingdom and the city, Chan saw a dramatic improvement after visiting a Hong Kong public dermatologist, whose...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: “有利有弊”：香港患者如何明智地使用远程医疗
items.summaryZh: 远程医疗在香港日益普及，为患者提供了便利的就医渠道。然而，医疗从业者提醒，远程医疗无法完全替代面对面的临床诊断。
items.whyImportant: 随着医疗数字化转型，如何平衡远程医疗的便捷性与诊疗的准确性成为公共卫生领域的重要议题。

items.title: Rewriting world history puts China’s image and ‘cultural security’ at risk: party journal
items.summary: Radically rewriting world and Chinese history without solid proof could threaten China’s international image and national identity, a leading Communist Party journal has warned. There has been a growing trend to promote a less Western-centric view of history in recent years, while Beijing has also been keen to promote the idea that Chinese civilisation has a long and continuous history. But at the same time, the so-called pseudo-historical school – which has cast doubt on the origins of Western...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 党刊警告：重写世界历史可能损害中国形象与“文化安全”
items.summaryZh: 中国共产党的一份主要期刊警告称，在缺乏确凿证据的情况下激进重写历史，可能会威胁到中国的国际形象和国家认同。文章指出，应警惕盲目否定西方文明起源的“伪史学”倾向。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了中国在维护文化主权和历史叙事方面的高度重视，以及对学术严谨性的政治要求。

items.title: ‘A victim’: American Bully dies in surgery, owners question fighting dog rules
items.summary: The owners of an American Bully are challenging the authorities’ classification of “fighting dogs” after their pet, a breed strictly controlled in Hong Kong, died during neutering, a procedure they undertook amid a crackdown on non-compliance. Monchiu, a female, died under anaesthesia during the operation at a veterinary clinic on Friday, her owners said on social media late on Saturday. They said the dog, who suffered from vision and hearing impairment, as well as skin problems, was unfit for...
items.titleZh: “受害者”：美国恶霸犬手术中死亡，主人质疑斗犬法规
items.summaryZh: 一只在香港被列为受严格管控品种的美国恶霸犬在绝育手术中因麻醉意外死亡。其主人在社交媒体上发声，质疑当局对“斗犬”的分类标准，并指出该犬只本身患有多种健康问题，不适合进行此类手术。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对于香港宠物管理法规合理性及执行细节的讨论与争议。

items.title: Alcaraz breezes into last eight at US Open
items.summary: Carlos Alcaraz beats American Tommy Paul in straight sets to reach US Open quarterfinals.
items.titleZh: 阿尔卡拉斯轻松晋级美网八强
items.summaryZh: 卡洛斯·阿尔卡拉斯直落三盘击败美国选手汤米·保罗，成功晋级美国网球公开赛四分之一决赛。
items.whyImportant: 作为网坛顶尖选手，阿尔卡拉斯的持续获胜进一步巩固了其在男子网坛的竞争地位。

items.title: Abdul El-Sayed uses speech to talk about Muslim faith and American identity
items.summary: Michigan Senate hopeful spoke about his faith and the experiences of Muslim Americans.
items.titleZh: 阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德在演讲中探讨穆斯林信仰与美国身份
items.summaryZh: 密歇根州参议院候选人阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德发表公开演讲，分享了其个人信仰经历以及穆斯林群体在美国社会中的身份认同。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了美国政治中关于宗教多元化与少数族裔政治参与的持续讨论。

items.title: Armed man arrested after charging towards Ohio governor candidate
items.summary: An armed assailant charged towards the Democratic candidate for Ohio governor, Amy Acton, on Sunday during a campaign stop at the Canfield Fair, injuring several people before he was stopped by troopers, the Ohio State Highway Patrol said. The Ohio State Highway Patrol said in a statement that a man it identified as Patrick Havas, 38, forced his way through a crowd, knocking over multiple members of the audience as he moved towards Acton, the state’s former public health director. He had a taser...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 一名持械男子在冲向俄亥俄州州长候选人时被捕
items.summaryZh: 一名持械男子在俄亥俄州州长候选人艾米·阿克顿的竞选活动中强行冲向候选人，造成多名观众受伤。该男子随后被州公路巡警制服并逮捕。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了对竞选活动安全保障措施以及政治人物人身安全的广泛关注。

items.title: Germany plans anti-sabotage shield after airport drone attack
items.summary: Germany is planning a broad package of measures to strengthen its defences against drone attacks, cyber intrusions and other forms of Russian sabotage after a failed airport drone attack ‌last month, an interior ministry spokesperson said on Sunday. Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt told the Bild am Sonntag newspaper, which first reported the plans, that Russia’s hybrid attacks had become a part of daily reality. “These attacks will increase, but we can ⁠defend and protect ourselves,”...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 德国计划在机场无人机袭击后建立反破坏防御盾
items.summaryZh: 继上月发生机场无人机袭击事件后，德国政府计划采取一系列综合措施，以加强对无人机袭击、网络入侵及俄罗斯破坏活动的防御。内政部长亚历山大·多布林特表示，此类混合攻击已成为日常现实，政府必须提升防御能力。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着德国在应对地缘政治紧张局势下，正大幅提升国家关键基础设施的安全防御等级。

items.title: 普京与美方会见超3小时 此前俄乌达成 三日停火 - 新华网
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 普京与美方会见超3小时 此前俄乌达成三日停火
items.summaryZh: 俄罗斯总统普京与美方代表进行了超过3小时的会晤。此前，俄乌双方已达成一项为期三天的停火协议。
items.whyImportant: 此次高层会晤及停火协议的达成，被视为缓解俄乌冲突紧张局势的重要外交尝试。
